# LansonAI — Full Documentation Index (machine-readable)

> LansonAI is the Voice Context Layer for live speech. This is the complete
> machine-readable documentation index for coding agents. Each entry links to
> the canonical page served by the docs site.
>
> Base URL: https://docs.lansonai.com
> Raw Markdown for any page: https://docs.lansonai.com/raw/docs/<path>.md
> OpenAPI spec (Recorded API): https://audio.lansonai.com/openapi.json
>
> Design principle: Human-readable + Agent-readable + Schema-accurate.
> Pages are organized by "what a developer wants to build", not by internal
> technology names. Technology concepts (StableStream™, Trinity Engine™) are
> explained only after a developer has chosen a capability.

## Get Started

- [Overview](/docs/start): LansonAI Developer Platform — Voice Context Layer; what you can build; Available / Preview / Coming soon capability matrix.
- [Quickstart](/docs/start/quickstart): 5-minute first real-time request. API Key → connect WebSocket → send audio → receive stable text.
- [Authentication](/docs/start/authentication): API Key, server-side usage, browser-side security (short-lived session token, HMAC), secret management.
- [SDKs](/docs/start/sdks): SDK status and direct HTTP / WebSocket usage.
- [Choose an API](/docs/start/choose-an-api): Realtime Voice Context vs Recorded Audio vs Voice Agent — decision table.

## Realtime Voice Context

- [Overview](/docs/realtime): What the Realtime API does, inputs, outputs, architecture diagram, vs Recorded.
- [Realtime Quickstart](/docs/realtime/quickstart): Shortest runnable WebSocket example (Python / TypeScript / browser JS).
- [Connection Lifecycle](/docs/realtime/connection-lifecycle): Connect → configure → stream audio → receive events → close/reconnect; state machine, timeouts, idle/session limits.
- [Audio Input](/docs/realtime/audio-input): PCM, sample rate, channels, chunk size, supported formats, chunk/latency tradeoffs.
- [Transcript Lifecycle](/docs/realtime/transcript-lifecycle): partial / stabilized / final semantics; audio → speech detected → working transcript → context stabilization → stable segment → final segment.
- [Realtime Translation](/docs/realtime/realtime-translation): Source/translation mapping, language config, language switching, latency behavior.
- [Session Configuration](/docs/realtime/session-configuration): language and session-level options; config timing (connect vs runtime).
- [Handling Interruptions & Silence](/docs/realtime/interruptions-silence): silence, pause, session continuation, VAD / end-of-speech behavior.

## Recorded Speech

- [Overview](/docs/recorded): Recorded vs Realtime, when to use which, current capability boundary.
- [Transcribe Audio](/docs/recorded/transcribe-audio): Upload file / URL → transcript; sync vs async (webhook / poll); file size / format limits.
- [Timestamps & Speakers](/docs/recorded/timestamps-speakers): word / segment timestamps, speaker diarization, field semantics and precision.
- [Subtitles](/docs/recorded/subtitles): SRT / VTT generation; segmentation rules; relation to timestamps.
- [Translation](/docs/recorded/translation): File-level translation.
- [Structured Results](/docs/recorded/structured-results): summary, chapters, action items — only genuinely stable outputs.

## Concepts

- [Voice Context Layer](/docs/concepts): What Voice Context is; vs raw STT output; why live speech needs a context layer.
- [Stable vs. Partial Text](/docs/concepts/stable-vs-partial-text): Why realtime speech text ≠ token stream; partial vs stable essence; don't self-manufacture jitter.
- [StableStream](/docs/concepts/stablestream): Technical contract page — when text can change, when stable, how a client should render to avoid jitter.
- [Context-Aware Processing](/docs/concepts/context-aware-processing): How context affects correction / stabilization; behavior, no internal implementation leakage.
- [Latency Model](/docs/concepts/latency): network / recognition / stabilization / translation latency; measurement and reduction.
- [Live Translation](/docs/concepts/live-translation): language config, language switching, latency behavior.
- [Trinity Engine](/docs/concepts/trinity-engine): Shared technology foundation — architecture / concept page.

## Guides

- [Overview](/docs/guides): Browser live captions and other runnable recipes.
- [Server-side Streaming](/docs/guides/server-side-streaming): Backend pushes audio stream; connection topology; auth / token management.
- [Build a Stable Caption UI](/docs/guides/stable-caption-ui): Consume StableStream events without jitter; partial / stabilized / final render strategy.
- [Build Live Translation](/docs/guides/live-translation): Bilingual / translated caption UI; side-by-side render; language-switch UI.
- [Save a Transcript](/docs/guides/save-transcript): Persist final transcript after session; final-segment fetch and merge.
- [Reconnect a Live Session](/docs/guides/reconnection): Network disconnect, retry, resume design; backoff strategy; session continuation boundaries.
- [Client-VAD Segments](/docs/guides/client-vad-segments): Client-side VAD speech segment transcription.

## API Reference

- [Overview](/docs/api-reference): Base URL, REST / WebSocket, versioning (`/v1/...`); per-endpoint template.
- [Realtime API](/docs/api-reference/realtime-api): WebSocket endpoint; connection URL and query params; auth; message format (JSON).
- [Client Messages](/docs/api-reference/client-messages): All client → Lanson messages; field schemas.
- [Server Events](/docs/api-reference/server-events): All Lanson → client events; field schemas; ordering and lifecycle.
- [Segment Transcription](/docs/api-reference/segment-transcription): `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` — synchronous multipart client-VAD transcription.
- [Batch Jobs](/docs/api-reference/batch-jobs): Async batch transcription jobs — enqueue and poll.
- [Languages & Models](/docs/api-reference/languages): Available languages; model / capability identifiers.
- [Errors](/docs/api-reference/errors): HTTP error codes; WebSocket error events; payload schema; common errors and triage.
- [Rate Limits](/docs/api-reference/rate-limits): Concurrency, requests, session duration; per-plan limits; over-limit behavior.
- [Admin API](/docs/api-reference/admin): Key provisioning, revocation, plan catalog (internal operators and dashboards only).

## Production

- [Production Checklist](/docs/production): Pre-production checks — auth / reconnect / rate-limit / monitoring / data-retention.
- [Reconnection & Retries](/docs/production/reconnection-retries): WebSocket disconnect, 429, 5xx, backoff; recommended retry strategy and boundaries.
- [Latency Best Practices](/docs/production/latency-best-practices): Audio chunks, connection reuse, region; end-to-end latency reduction.
- [Security & Privacy](/docs/production/security-privacy): Data handling, API key security, retention policy.
- [Data Retention](/docs/production/data-retention): Whether audio / transcript is stored; duration; how to delete.
- [Changelog](/docs/production/changelog): API-breaking changes, new fields, deprecations; reverse-chronological.

## Operational endpoints

- [OpenAPI spec](https://audio.lansonai.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI for the Recorded API.
- [Health](https://audio.lansonai.com/health): Liveness probe.
- [Status](https://control.lansonai.com/status/lanson-audio): Service status dashboard.

## Notes for coding agents

- The Realtime WebSocket API contract is defined in `/docs/api-reference/client-messages` and `/docs/api-reference/server-events`.
- The transcript state machine contract is defined in `/docs/realtime/transcript-lifecycle` and `/docs/concepts/stablestream`.
- Raw Markdown for any page: `https://docs.lansonai.com/raw/docs/<path>.md` (e.g. `/raw/docs/start/quickstart.md`).
- The Recorded API OpenAPI spec at `https://audio.lansonai.com/openapi.json` is the schema-accurate source for recorded endpoints.
